analysis.session_summary: USD was the weakest major, down 0.81% on average, while JPY led gains at +1.736% as BOJ quarter-point hike reports hit. Fed Governor Waller signaled he would support holding rates steady in September, and US jobless claims had an inverted reaction with USD weakening 0.108% on a beat, reinforcing dollar selling. Swiss CPI beat drove CHF +0.172% and USD/CHF fell 72.8 pips. Equities rose (SPX +79.0) and VIX fell (-38.9), keeping risk appetite stronger but not supporting USD/JPY.

themes.theme: Broad USD weakness with risk-on equities
themes.evidence: DXY -70.7, USD mean vs majors -0.81%, SPX +79.0, VIX -38.9, EUR/USD +49.3 pips, GBP/USD +49.8 pips

themes.theme: BOJ hike speculation drives yen strength
themes.evidence: USD/JPY -348.8 pips to close at 155.358, close in 0.02 of range, JPY strength +1.736%, BOJ said to favor quarter-point hike

themes.theme: Swiss franc gets CPI inflation impulse
themes.evidence: Swiss CPI m/m actual 0.4% vs forecast 0.0%, CHF own-ccy impulse +0.172%, USD/CHF -72.8 pips, EUR/CHF -44.5 pips

themes.theme: US labor data fails to support the dollar
themes.evidence: Unemployment Claims actual 206K vs forecast 205K but USD weakened 0.108%, Fed Waller indicated holding rates steady

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD opened with a -3.3-pip Asia dip, then rallied 54.0 pips into the 18:45 close, with Waller and claims adding 9.1 pips each, closing at the top of a 58.4-pip range.
leg_notes.GBP/USD: GBP/USD fell -11.3 pips early, then rose 64.2 pips with Waller and claims each contributing 16.2 pips, ending near the high of a 68.6-pip range.
leg_notes.USD/JPY: USD/JPY initially rose 10.3 pips, then cratered -362.3 pips as BOJ hike speculation hit, closing at the bottom of a 370.9-pip range.
leg_notes.USD/CHF: USD/CHF fell -68.3 pips on Swiss CPI, rebounded +28.8 pips on ISM services, then dropped -34.8 pips to close at the low of an 82.5-pip range.
leg_notes.AUD/USD: AUD/USD had a -6.8-pip early dip, a +44.6-pip rally on Waller/claims, a -17.7-pip ISM dip, then a +18.0-pip late recovery to close at 0.97 of a 48.0-pip range.
leg_notes.NZD/USD: NZD/USD swung in five legs (+9.1, -14.5, +30.3, -17.3, +37.2) to net +43.0 pips, closing near the top of a 56.6-pip range.
leg_notes.USD/CAD: USD/CAD moved in one -72.3-pip leg to close at the low of an 83.5-pip range, as CAD firmed with broad USD weakness.
leg_notes.EUR/CHF: EUR/CHF fell -46.6 pips on Swiss CPI, bounced +23.5 pips on ISM services, then slid -22.0 pips to close near the low of a 51.2-pip range.
leg_notes.CHF/JPY: CHF/JPY rose +16.0 pips early, then fell -273.1 pips with yen strength to close near the low of a 343.8-pip range.
leg_notes.EUR/GBP: EUR/GBP chopped +14.2, -8.5, +12.3, -14.1 pips, netting only +4.9 pips in a 22.8-pip range.

polarity_reads.read: A normal beat-surprise reaction pushed CHF +0.172%, showing the market treats Swiss inflation upside as reducing SNB easing odds.
An inverted beat-surprise reaction weakened USD 0.108%, implying positioning is short USD and good US data is being sold rather than bought.
A muted 0.028% basket move despite a 55.4 vs 54.2 beat suggests services data was already priced or not a USD driver at this stage.
A muted 0.004% basket move indicates no fresh kiwi positioning shift from RBNZ communication; NZD is being driven by USD side flows.

scenarios.name: BOJ hike repricing keeps USD/JPY heavy
scenarios.thesis: BOJ quarter-point hike speculation and broad USD weakness keep yen supported; USD/JPY closed at the bottom of its range with little bounce.
scenarios.invalidation: USD/JPY recovers above 155.358 and US yields rise, or Fed speakers push back on dovish pricing.

pair_paths.rationale: Measured USD/JPY range today was 370.9 pips and price closed at 0.02 of range, showing sellers dominate.
CHF/JPY fell with JPY strength; range 343.8 pips, closed at 0.19 of range.
USD weakness from DXY -70.7 and EUR/USD up 49.3 pips, range 58.4.

scenarios.name: US data and Fed pushback trigger USD short-covering
scenarios.thesis: Upcoming NFP forecast 55K vs -23K prior and average hourly earnings could force USD shorts to cover, reversing part of today's dollar weakness.
triggers: Average Hourly Earnings m/m prints above 0.3%
Fed speakers signal less urgency to cut
scenarios.invalidation: US claims or PMI continue to trigger inverted USD weakness; USD/JPY makes fresh lows.

pair_paths.rationale: Rebound within today's 370.9-pip range as short JPY unwinds.
EUR/USD erases its +49.3-pip gain within 58.4-pip range if USD bounces.
USD/CHF retraces its -72.8-pip drop within 82.5-pip range.

scenarios.name: Pre-NFP consolidation in wide ranges
scenarios.thesis: Markets may hold before NFP, with USD/JPY and G10 mostly inside today's ranges after strong directional moves.
scenarios.invalidation: Break of today's USD/JPY 370.9-pip range or EUR/USD 58.4-pip range on headline.

pair_paths.rationale: EUR/USD closed near top of 58.4-pip range; consolidation within that range.
After a 370.9-pip range day, USD/JPY may coil inside it.
GBP/USD closed at 0.94 of its 68.6-pip range; likely to hold inside range.
